# Kabod Crest Limited

> A distinguished Nigerian diversified enterprise committed to ethical agro-processing, pristine agricultural exports, food security, and strategic commercial ventures. Headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria with worldwide delivery operations to the United Kingdom, United States, Canada, Australia, South Africa, and across all 36 Nigerian states.

## Core Food & Agro-Produce Products
- [Whole Agro Catalog](https://kabodcrest.com/shop): Complete commercial catalog of unadulterated Nigerian food harvests.
- [Dehydrated Ugwu Fluted Pumpkin](https://kabodcrest.com/product-detail?id=dehydrated-ugwu): Clean room dehydrated Telfairia occidentalis leaves with sub-8% moisture retention, preservative-free, vacuum-sealed for 12 months pantry stability.
- [Dehydrated Ginger Root](https://kabodcrest.com/product-detail?id=dehydrated-ginger): High gingerol-content Kaduna sun-cured ginger.
- [Artisanal Jollof Spice Blend](https://kabodcrest.com/product-detail?id=jollof-rice-spice): Stone-ground heritage spice blend (bay leaf, thyme, ginger, garlic, paprika, allium) without artificial flavor enhancers.
- [Melon Seed Egusi](https://kabodcrest.com/product-detail?id=melon-seed-egusi): Machine-hulled, stone-sorted, high-protein Citrullus lanatus seed.
- [Fermented Locust Beans Iru](https://kabodcrest.com/product-detail?id=iru-locust-beans): Naturally fermented Parkia biglobosa, slow-dehydrated into odorless, long-life dry savory umami crystals.
- [Wild Dika Kernels Ogbono](https://kabodcrest.com/product-detail?id=ogbono-dika-nut): Wild-harvested Irvingia gabonensis kernels with premium mucilage draw.
- [Hibiscus Flower Calyces Zobo](https://kabodcrest.com/product-detail?id=zobo-hibiscus-calyces): Grade-A sorted deep purple Hibiscus sabdariffa for herbal teas and botanical extracts.

## Enterprise Verticals
- [Business Services](https://kabodcrest.com/business-services): Strategic corporate advisory, bulk agricultural contract supply, export container logistics, and private-label retail packaging.
- [Hospitality & Food Services](https://kabodcrest.com/hospitality): Modern West African culinary dining concepts, chef collaborations, and terroir-driven gastronomy.
- [Events & Experiences](https://kabodcrest.com/events): Executive retreats, private cultural celebrations, and brand showcases designed with spatial and acoustic restraint.

## Customer & Commerce Services
- [Order Dispatch Tracking](https://kabodcrest.com/track-order): Real-time lookup for order dispatches using reference numbers (KC-2026-XXXX) and customer email.
- [Worldwide Delivery](https://kabodcrest.com/checkout): Flat rate ₦1,000 nationwide logistics across Nigeria, plus reliable air freight to global diaspora hubs.
- [Corporate Desk](https://kabodcrest.com/contact): Official inquiries, telephone, WhatsApp, and physical presence in Lagos, Nigeria.

## Operational Standards
- **Integrity**: Zero artificial fillers, colorants, or chemical preservatives.
- **Hygiene**: Multi-stage wash cycles, clean-room tray dehydration below 55°C to preserve active chlorophyll and volatile oils.
- **Packaging**: Multi-layer aluminum foil standup barrier pouches with resealable airtight zip closures to block light, moisture, and oxidation.
